text_block_list.text: One day, a fan letter arrived for Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wah! A letter! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
I will now check the contents.
The guards appeared smoothly and began briskly inspecting the contents of the fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"There was no danger over here.
If you'll excuse me, then."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Getting even one fan letter is tough, huh
Getting even one fan letter is tough, isn't it

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Part of me wants to open the seal myself, but...
I was taught from a young age
to always prepare for the worst.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "My parents told me that a daughter of an old, noble family shouldn't race, and I was about to give up on my dream, but then I learned about you."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Carrying both the duty of family and dreams as an athlete. I want to become just like you, marching forward with both in hand. That is my dream now."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"‘When we meet on the turf one day, please let
me thank you once again in person’... huh."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was running for the sake of my own dream,
but it turns out it was connected to someone else's dream, too.
choice_data_list: I hope I get to race with her someday too.
It'd be nice to race with her someday too, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I hope we can clash with everything we have, run our absolute best race, and smile together knowing that our path always keeps moving forward.
choice_data_list: To achieve that, practice is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'll do my super best~!

The warm messages in the fan letters
seemed to provide her with wonderful encouragement.
